title: 1989 Bowman #166 Andy Hawkins New York Yankees Pitcher Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
1989 Bowman #166 Andy Hawkins, New York Yankees pitcher. The signature on the front is the printed facsimile Bowman used on every 1989 card, not an autograph. Small factory print smudge on the name on the back (see close-up).

Ships in an eBay Standard Envelope.
